post.summary: Create an API key

post.description: Opens a hosted payment that collects the first period and establishes the mandate future charges ride on. Returns the URL to redirect the customer to. Entitlement is granted only once the payment is confirmed by the provider webhook — this endpoint grants nothing.
post.summary: Open a checkout for a paid plan

post.description: Schedules a move to a smaller tier, effective at the next renewal. Nothing changes today and nothing is refunded: the tenant keeps the tier they paid for until the current period ends. Moving to the free tier is a cancellation, not a downgrade.
post.summary: Schedule a downgrade to a smaller plan

422.description: not a downgrade, or use cancellation for the free tier

delete.description: Withdraws a scheduled downgrade before it fires. Idempotent: withdrawing when nothing is scheduled succeeds.

get.description: Returns the subscription's health: which tier is paid for, whether a payment failed and until when it can still be fixed, and any scheduled change. A tenant who never subscribed is reported healthy with hasSubscription=false — the free tier is not a degraded state.
get.summary: Get the calling tenant's billing state

delete.description: Stops future charges. Access is NOT revoked: the period already paid for keeps entitling until it lapses, and the response carries that date. Idempotent.

post.description: Moves the tenant to a larger tier, effective immediately. The prorated difference is charged on the existing mandate BEFORE the tier is applied: a declined charge leaves the tier untouched. Requires explicit consent to the amount returned by the quote endpoint.
post.summary: Upgrade to a larger plan

404.description: no subscription — open a checkout instead

409.description: the quoted amount was not consented to

422.description: not an upgrade, or the subscription cannot change tier

post.description: Returns the prorated amount owed today for moving to a larger tier — the difference between the tiers for the time remaining in the period already paid, never the catalogue price. Charges nothing. An amount of 0 means the upgrade is granted without a charge.
post.summary: Quote what an upgrade would cost

post.description: Ingests Lungor's subscription lifecycle events. Authenticated by HMAC signature, not by API key — never called by clients.

post.description: Receives payment notifications from Mollie. The body is unsigned and carries only a payment id, so the payment is re-fetched with the API key before anything is applied — the authenticated read is the security boundary. Idempotent: replayed notifications are acknowledged without being re-applied.

200.description: acknowledged — applied, replayed, or attributable to nobody

400.description: no payment id in the body

500.description: not applied — the provider should retry

post.description:
Public endpoint hit by mail-client user-agents. Accepts either
`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` with `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click&token=...`
or `application/json` with `{"token": "..."}`. Always returns 200 on
a valid token, even when the recipient is already suppressed (idempotent).

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Bearer <token>`. Accepts a managed sk_live_* key, an HS256 JWT, or the static API_KEY.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

secret.description: returned ONCE on creation; never again

plan.description: Plan is the smaller tier to move to at the next renewal.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description:
CancelAtPeriodEnd reports that future charges are stopped while the paid
period still runs.

endsAt.description:
EndsAt is the deadline the tenant is still acting inside when a payment
failed. Empty once access has already stopped: there is no future date
left to promise.

entitled.description:
Entitled reports whether the tenant may currently be served on their paid
tier. A canceled subscription is still entitled until the period lapses.

hasSubscription.description:
HasSubscription is false for a tenant who never paid. Never having
subscribed is not a payment problem.

pendingPlanName.description:
PendingPlanName is a scheduled downgrade that has not fired. It grants
nothing — it is a promise about the next period.

state.description: State is one of healthy, payment_failed, suspended.

status.description: Status is the raw lifecycle status: active, past_due, canceled.

includedEmails.description:
IncludedEmails is what the subscription price buys. On a plan with no
hard cap it is the only number that tells a tenant where billing starts,
since Limit is -1 there.

overageEmails.description:
OverageEmails is how much of SentCount sits past IncludedEmails, and
OverageCents what it would cost. Reported, not yet invoiced — see the
note on Pro in plans/domain/catalog.go.

identityId.description:
IdentityID is optional and deprecated. When omitted, the server
resolves the identity from the domain of the From address — match the
industry baseline (Resend, SES, Postmark). When provided, it must
agree with the From domain; otherwise the request is rejected.

rfc5322Id.description: value of the RFC 5322 Message-ID header

email.description:
Email and Name are optional; the server resolves the billing contact when
they are absent.

plan.description:
Plan is the tier being bought. Only purchasable tiers are accepted:
reaching the free tier is a cancellation, not a purchase.

successUrl.description: SuccessURL overrides where the customer lands after paying.

periodEnd.description:
PeriodEnd is when the current period runs out, and therefore when the
full price of the new tier starts applying.

acceptedCents.description:
AcceptedCents is the prorated amount the customer agreed to, from a prior
quote. It is verified against a freshly computed amount: a stale quote
must not authorise a different charge.

consented.description:
Consented records that the amount was shown and agreed to. Required for
any charge above the proration floor.

plan.description: Plan is the larger tier to move to.
